date.as_written: saṃmvata 1063 varṣya paukhamāse suklapakṣe pratipadāyān tithau 1 roja 5

notes: No personal names are preserved or mentioned in the colophon. It concludes with the date of completion of copying (coya sidhayakā jula) and an exhortation/pious reflection in Newari addressed to sentient beings regarding devotion to Śrī Karuṇāmaya.
